title: BEVFusion: Multi-Task Multi-Sensor Fusion with Unified Bird's-Eye View Representation
layout_note: Two parallel horizontal rows (camera on top, LiDAR below) of encoder -> features -> view transform -> BEV feature grid, which converge diagonally into one stacked two-colour BEV block, then a single row (BEV Encoder -> Fused BEV Features) forks via a bracket arrow into a column of task-head output images on the right.
grouping: No containers or background panels: the two modality branches are grouped purely by colour family (orange outlines/fills for every camera-side element, blue for every LiDAR-side element) and the fused stage switches to teal; task heads are grouped as a stacked column of framed output images under a 'Task-Specific Heads' title with a vertical ellipsis between them.
shapes_depth: Encoders are flat trapezoid pairs (a large then small trapezoid, BEV encoder as a mirrored hourglass pair); camera features are a fanned stack of offset flat sheets, LiDAR and BEV features are 3-D gridded cuboids with light fills; the two view-transform operations are rounded squares holding a small black pictogram (frustum, flatten-press); output heads are photos with a tinted label strip underneath. Thick short black arrows join every step.
proposed_highlight: The fusion step is the only place the two colour families meet: an orange BEV grid stacked directly on a blue BEV grid in one cuboid at the visual centre, after which everything turns teal; 'BEV' is set in bold inside the feature labels.
lesson: Colour each sensor branch in its own family through every element and show fusion as the two coloured feature grids literally stacked into one block, then switch to a third colour for everything downstream.
notes: venue = arXiv (remembered venue: ICRA 2023; not printed on the arXiv first page); year = arXiv preprint year. `refs crop` reported 'no figure graphics found' for fig2 on page 2, so the crop was cut by hand from the page's drawing and image bounding boxes at 200 dpi (crops/2205.13542/fig2.png with a fig2.json listing the embedded image boxes, so photo_share is measured). The three input photos and two head outputs are embedded rasters. Fig 1 is a teaser comparing fusion spaces.

taxonomy.task: multi-sensor BEV 3D detection and map segmentation

insights.structure: Camera and LiDAR branches run as two parallel rows of identical step types (encoder, features, view transform, BEV grid), converge diagonally into one stacked block in the middle, and a single shared trunk then forks into a right-hand column of task heads.
insights.data: Inputs and task outputs are real images (a stacked set of street photos, a black LiDAR sweep, a coloured BEV map, a LiDAR BEV with orange boxes), while intermediates are drawn as stacked sheets for 2D camera features and gridded 3-D cuboids for voxel and BEV features.
insights.emphasis: The fused BEV block stacks an orange camera grid on a blue LiDAR grid so the fusion is visible as geometry and colour, and every downstream element turns teal to mark the unified space.
insights.flow: Short thick black arrows run left to right along each row, two short diagonal arrows bring both BEV grids into the centre block, and a bracket-shaped arrow splits the fused features to the two head images at the right edge.
insights.avoid: The view-transform icons (a tiny frustum, a flatten press) are small black pictograms that are hard to decode at print size, and the elided heads are only a bare ellipsis between two images.

arrangement.units: two unframed horizontal lanes (camera top, LiDAR bottom) separated by whitespace and colour family, merging into a central fused-BEV trunk, plus a right column of two framed head images with tinted label strips
arrangement.inputs_as: real photos: a stacked fan of multi-view street images and a LiDAR point-cloud render, each labelled underneath
arrangement.losses_at: none drawn; task heads are shown as output images
arrangement.shared: the BEV encoder and fused features are drawn once in the merged trunk feeding all heads

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
